name: When do I need to call a professional for water damage instead of cleaning it myself?

mainEntity.name: When do I need to call a professional for water damage instead of cleaning it myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should call a professional for water damage when the affected area is large, involves contaminated water (like sewage), or if the water has been present for more than 24-48 hours. Professionals have specialized equipment to thoroughly dry hidden areas, preventing mold growth and structural damage that DIY methods often miss. Ignoring professional help in significant cases can lead to long-term health risks and costly repairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Call a professional for large areas, contaminated water, or if water has been present over 24-48 hours. They have equipment to prevent mold and structural damage.
